environment.description: EKS pod deployed in private subnet (10.0.8.0/24) associated with route table rtb-0f8c2b4a6d. The subnet's route table contains only local VPC routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and VPC endpoint routes for the MSK and RDS interfaces. There is no NAT gateway, internet gateway, or VPC peering connection providing a path to any non-VPC CIDR. The pod runs with a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy (calico) restricting egress to only the RDS endpoint (10.0.12.0/28 port 5432) and MSK broker ENIs (10.0.14.0/28 ports 9092-9094). DNS resolution is handled by a Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint within the VPC. The security group (sg-0d9e1f3a5b7c) attached to the pod ENI has outbound rules limited to 10.0.12.0/28:5432 and 10.0.14.0/28:9092-9094 with no other egress allowed. The RDS instance uses IAM database authentication with the pod's IRSA role granted only INSERT on users(username, normalized_name, status) via a PostgreSQL row-level function wrapper.

config.network_policy: calico egress allow 10.0.12.0/28:5432, 10.0.14.0/28:9092-9094; deny all other
config.db_permissions: EXECUTE on function insert_user(text, text) only - function validates and parameterizes internally
